knowledge:
- key_parameters: dir=path to the directory containing raw HDF5 files ;; setName=character string to name the ptrSet object ;; mzCalibRef=numeric vector of reference masses used for mass calibration ;; fracMaxTIC=fraction of maximum TIC (between 0 and 1) used to define expiration or headspace limits (set to 0 to analyze the entire spectrum, e.g., for ambient air) ;; mzBreathTracer=mass used to trace expiration (if NULL, the total TIC trace is used) ;; group=character string specifying the metadata column used for alignment grouping ;; fracGroup=minimum percentage of samples in at least one group where a peak must be detected to be kept during alignment ;; fracExp=minimum percentage of samples where peak intensity must be significantly higher than background to be kept ;; smoothPenalty=penalty for peak detection smoothing (set to 0 for headspace/mycobacteria data)
- alternatives: ropls=R package recommended for downstream multivariate statistical analysis (PCA, PLS) on the generated ExpressionSet ;; biosigner=R package recommended for downstream feature selection ;; RunShinnyApp=function to run the entire workflow interactively via a Shiny graphical user interface instead of the command line
- when_to_use: Appropriate for preprocessing raw PTR-TOF-MS data from exhaled breath, cell culture headspace, or ambient air studies to generate a clean, aligned, and annotated peak intensity table.
- pitfalls: Low mass calibration drift can occur during acquisition; periodic calibration is performed every calibrationPeriods seconds (default 60) to correct this ;; If a reference mass has calibration errors > 20 ppm, check the files using plotCalib and consider removing or changing the reference masses ;; Row names of the sampleMetadata must always correspond exactly to the file names in the directory; modifying or missing row names during import will throw an error ;; Truncated mass axes in demo datasets require adjusting mzCalibRef to only include present masses.

workflows.name: multi_file_preprocessing_workflow
workflows.intent: Preprocess a directory of raw PTR-TOF-MS HDF5 files to calibrate, detect peaks, align samples, impute missing values, annotate VOCs, and export an ExpressionSet.
input: raw_directory/ (directory containing raw PTR-TOF-MS HDF5 files with .h5 extension)
workflows.stages: 1. Create ptrSet object and perform initial calibration and time limit detection using createPtrSet ;; 2. Fine-tune mass calibration using calibration ;; 3. Check calibration errors using plot ;; 4. Visualize total ion chromatograms and limits using plotTIC ;; 5. Manage sample metadata using getSampleMetadata and setSampleMetadata ;; 6. Update ptrSet if files are added or deleted using updatePtrSet ;; 7. Detect and quantify peaks using detectPeak ;; 8. Align peaks across samples to create an ExpressionSet using alignSamples ;; 9. Impute missing values using impute ;; 10. Annotate peaks with VOC database information using annotateVOC ;; 11. Export the ExpressionSet to tabular files using writeEset
workflows.code:
dirRaw <- system.file("extdata/exhaledAir", package = "ptairData")
exhaledPtrset <- createPtrSet(dir=dirRaw,
                     setName="exhaledPtrset",
                     mzCalibRef = c(21.022, 60.0525),fracMaxTIC = 0.7,
                     saveDir = NULL )
exhaledPtrset <- calibration(exhaledPtrset, mzCalibRef =  c(21.022, 60.0525,75.04406))
plot(exhaledPtrset,type="calibError")
plotTIC(object = exhaledPtrset,baselineRm = TRUE,type = "ggplot")
sampleMD <- getSampleMetadata(exhaledPtrset)
colnames(sampleMD)[1] <- "individual"  
exhaledPtrset <- setSampleMetadata(exhaledPtrset,sampleMD)
exhaledPtrset <- updatePtrSet(exhaledPtrset)
exhaledPtrset <- detectPeak(exhaledPtrset)
exhaledEset <- alignSamples(exhaledPtrset, group="individual", fracGroup = 1, fracExp=1/6)
exhaledEset <- ptairMS::impute(exhaledEset,  exhaledPtrset)
exhaledEset<-annotateVOC(exhaledEset)
writeEset(exhaledEset, dirC = file.path(getwd(), "processed_dataset"))

workflows.name: single_file_raw_inspection
workflows.intent: Read, calibrate, and inspect raw data and expiration limits from a single PTR-TOF-MS HDF5 file.
input: sample_file.h5 (a single raw PTR-TOF-MS HDF5 file)
workflows.stages: 1. Read the raw HDF5 file into a ptrRaw object using readRaw ;; 2. Determine and plot expiration limits using timeLimits
workflows.code:
dirRaw <- system.file("extdata/exhaledAir", package = "ptairData")
samplePath<-list.files(dirRaw,recursive = TRUE,full.names = TRUE,pattern = ".h5$")[1]
sampleRaw <- readRaw(samplePath, calib = FALSE)
expirationLimit <- timeLimits(sampleRaw,fracMaxTIC =  0.5,plotDel = TRUE, mzBreathTracer = 60.05)
expirationLimit <- timeLimits(sampleRaw,fracMaxTIC =  0.9,plotDel = TRUE,mzBreathTracer = NULL)
